purpose: Portable high-value mechanism, counterexample and theoretical-bound evidence; GT/oracle and causal-scope limits are retained verbatim in source content. No predictions, masks, dense arrays, images or raw task manifests.

source_query_identifiability.purpose: Fixed-family source self-fit versus query oracle capacity; prevents claiming DINO has no usable information.

content.warning: Not segmentation benchmark scores: heldout soft token IoU and AUC, oracle use of query train-block labels. Within-image context is shared.

native_task_protocol.purpose: Define full input, hard/soft compressed aliases, task family and membership.

content.primary: exact complete reference Mask; all legal native categories and same-bbox parent choices
content.membership: reference oracle annotation only; no prediction/error/score selection
content.access_caveat: Catalog pickle includes annotations of all photos; functional membership only examines current R. Do not call the catalog physically query-label-free.
content.query_phase: only candidates aliased under full/hard/soft signatures; all native Q masks and parent choices at exact fixed crop

native_reference_membership.purpose: 6200 task and5373 unique-reference counts and membership hash.

native_corrected_oracle_membership.purpose: Corrected native-input uniqueness/consensus and four hard-compression query aliases.

content.reason: Initial query implementation omitted candidate concepts absent from Q catalog; frozen spec requires retaining empty answers

native_alias_matched_sensitivity.purpose: Four-case matched descriptive sensitivity; not average causal ambiguity effect.

content.interpretation: Descriptive same-class/size sensitivity only; not a causal ambiguity effect or a full-input oracle effect

native_analysis_protocol.purpose: Metric, matching and cross-protocol coverage boundaries.

content.cross_protocol_family: COCO-20i and LVIS-92i native uncropped tasks on available identical decoded RGB; all allowed native categories
content.cross_protocol_membership: Exact full reference Mask equality; identical native R/Q pixel inputs; no approximate equality, forced crop, or category-name matching
content.cross_protocol_scope: Only local counterparts; missing counterpart is not a negative finding. Other domains have no shared native frame in these local sources.
content.cross_protocol_semantic_caveat: A different annotated answer is a protocol witness, not automatically a natural semantic ambiguity; annotation boundary differences require adjudication.
content.subsets: all, full task unique, full query identifiable, hard reference unique/alias, hard query identifiable with/without query-positive prior, soft reference unique, unresolved
content.metric: Class-pooled I/U using the frozen expected per-fold class slots; missing slots zero only for the fixed-slot descriptive metric. Empty subsets return null.
content.matching: For each hard alias, nearest available nonalias of same fold and global category in log GT fraction and log image aspect/area; prefer disjoint R/Q photos; no replacement
content.matching_caveat: Four aliases only; descriptive sensitivity, no causal or population inference
content.four_edits: N versus FoRIS and N versus same-count K; reuse native4000 saved gross edits, reconstruct old2200 from sealed masks and official nearest-aligned GT

native_cross_protocol_coverage.purpose: Only330 complete cross-protocol pair checks; noncoverage must not be counted as no ambiguity.

content.coverage_caveat: Counts apply to exact available local native counterpart pairs, not the whole task family or all five datasets

native_subset_performance.purpose: Exact native/full/alias subset counts, pooled integers and own metric definitions; not replacement of other cohort score weighting.

native_analysis_completion.purpose: Completed audit does not mean Strong method goal achieved.

content.scientific_goal: Five-domain unified Strong method is not established by this diagnostic audit

strong_witness_three_cases.purpose: Three GT-selected counterexamples: false restorations can have pure RFG support; full BG can reject correct restoration. Preserve selection boundary.

content.boundary: Descriptive GT-selected3 cases; canonical weighted pixel mass uses native nearest source witness, not exact per-pixel interpolated winner. FullBG role contrast is a diagnostic only.

tangent_uncertainty_correction.purpose: Authoritative corrected R/Q photo groups and uncertainty intervals; supersedes legacy SUIM degenerate intervals.

content.correction: Legacy SUIM photo IDs are null; old str(None) grouping incorrectly collapsed all20 pairs to one group and produced degenerate intervals. Use actual photo IDs or verified decoded RGB SHA when missing.
content.unchanged: All predictions, labels, per-task I/U and point estimates are unchanged. Original frozen reports and producer scripts retained for provenance; this addendum supersedes their affected confidence intervals.
content.resampling: 2000 bootstrap draws of connected reference/query photo components; average two tasks within each pair. Exposed development photos, not untouched confirmation.

tangent_threshold_ceiling.purpose: Exact threshold-oracle summaries constrain calibration-only explanation; oracle is not deployable.

content.limits: Oracle chooses threshold using query GT; excludes CRF or arbitrary spatial masks. Best level-set ability is not a usable calibration method or generalization proof.

tangent_loss_attribution.purpose: Exact IoU contribution of repair FN, spoil TP, remove FP, add FP across three tangent readouts.

content.definitions: Four pixel edits priced at candidate union: exact accounting, not a causal/Shapley module attribution.
content.photo_identity: Real photo ID if present, otherwise verified decoded RGB SHA; never str(None)
content.scope: All60 fixed realMask pairs of three sealed tangent investigations; CLI1024 complete masks, per-photo two-task mean, connected-R/Q-photo bootstrap.

context_readout_diagnosis.purpose: Rank/distribution exchange controls show much of gain over weak linear context is distribution readout, not improved spatial task ranking.

content.caveat: Post-hoc diagnosis on already exposed outputs. Average-rank ties may alter marginal area slightly. IoU is nonlinear; crossed gains are not additive causal allocation.

unified_mechanism_claims.purpose: Falsifiable claims, counterclaims and scope; preserves meaningful negative knowledge.

claims.claim: Existing raw O24 features admit substantially better task ranking in the fixed linear diagnostic family than reference-only training obtains.
claims.scope: 60 fixed R/Q pairs, two real tasks per pair; label-assisted spatial-fold diagnostic, not a deployable selector or full original mIoU.
claims.counterclaim_rejected: DINO embeddings contain no task information or all failures are encoder information loss.
claims.falsification_boundary: A different family or unseen-photo validation can alter the capacity and transfer conclusion; oracle directions cannot be deployed.

claims.claim: Finite reference supervision allows different query explanations in the tested family; better reference fitting, coverage or reconstruction does not identify the correct query task.
claims.scope: Conditional ambiguity of chosen supervision/readout, not a universal impossibility theorem for a single reference.
claims.counterclaim_rejected: A high reference IoU, pure coverage token, positive source separation or low query feature-fit error authorizes query deletion/addition.
claims.falsification_boundary: A legal reference/query rule that separates the competing task explanations could resolve this gap; existing evidence does not establish such a rule.

claims.claim: Reference-to-query changes affect both ranking and absolute FG/BG readout; large background mass can amplify small score shifts into false foreground.
claims.scope: Observed conditional means/ranks and complete masks; package-level readout mismatch, not isolated causal blame on one BG operator.
claims.counterclaim_rejected: The only missing element is a reference scalar threshold, target prior or spatial reconstruction.
claims.falsification_boundary: An executed strong readout with preserved target semantics could use the same geometry differently; present Pro failure does not refute every geometry method.

claims.claim: Old C/N fusion can delete correct FoRIS foreground and cannot recover it through N's G-only admission: N intersect B equals C intersect B.
claims.scope: Actual old6200 computes Boolean C/N independently in CLI/original, so the identity holds in both; it restricts reachable outputs of that fixed fusion and does not erase upstream/cached mask information. Do not transfer it to new1300 whole-mask rendering.
claims.counterclaim_rejected: Adding an N foreground-admission module fixes every coverage loss of C.
claims.falsification_boundary: A genuinely revised complete decision path may reopen these deletions, but must report the FP cost on PACO1/75/COCO1/13; never-delete-B is not a solution.

claims.claim: Most old N gain over C is also obtained by its same-addition-count own-MEAN ranking control K; the five-domain original N-K residual is tiny.
claims.scope: Same existing cohort/frame/budget comparisons; real local successes and losses remain.
claims.counterclaim_rejected: N's total gain over FoRIS demonstrates broad new reference-identity discrimination.
claims.falsification_boundary: A new complete method must outperform appropriate simple and matched-budget controls without domain switching; a module need not beat full FoRIS by itself.

claims.claim: A dead scalar gate or lower intermediate task AUC does not establish irreversible task loss of the complete model when other reference-mask paths remain.
claims.scope: Only a joint frontier covering every remaining mask-to-decision path could support a full-model collision argument.
claims.counterclaim_rejected: The first observed branch-score drop is the earliest irrecoverable bottleneck of the full model.
claims.falsification_boundary: Need fixed R/Q and random state, identical all-path frontier for distinct valid masks, and distinct required task answers. This evidence is absent; no new collision experiment is requested.

claims.claim: Pro200's raw conservation and paired reconstruction fit are real, but do not preserve labels under later normalization and nonlinear KDE; low-rank local correction cannot alter all linear directions.
claims.scope: Correction lies in span(V), while global PG remains. Shuffle changes direction and alpha, so it is not a clean amplitude-matched correspondence intervention.
claims.counterclaim_rejected: AZ=G implies correct masks, or rank64 erases all task information of Z.
claims.falsification_boundary: Any use of geometry needs complete strong-readout outputs and controls; interpolation/alignment diagnostics alone cannot certify semantic improvement.

conditional_decision_principle.purpose: Conditional affine-cone argument and why generic semantic certificate was rejected; not an executed method.

content.principle: Only change a disputed query decision if every admissible explanation of the legal reference labels agrees; otherwise preserve the strong complete FoRIS readout.

generic_semantic_certificate.judgment: Rejected as a sufficient consequence of reference agreement alone
generic_semantic_certificate.reason: An unrestricted finite-label-consistent family can label unseen query features either way; a restricted family's agreement does not establish that the true task belongs to it.

single_formal_conditional_family.representation: Fixed original unit O24 augmented with intercept; no new feature tap/head/normalization/radius
single_formal_conditional_family.reference_labels: Every existing official hard-role label derived from legal R binary mask; explicitly different from source model predictions and full-resolution mixed-pixel truth
single_formal_conditional_family.version_space: V={theta: y_i * z_Ri dot theta > 0 for every R constraint}
single_formal_conditional_family.equivalent_feasibility: y_i * z_Ri dot theta >= 1; finite strict feasible constraints permit uniform positive scaling, so 1 fixes no semantic norm
single_formal_conditional_family.empty_family_action: No modification; never use vacuous unanimity
single_formal_conditional_family.foreground_certificate: z_Q = sum_i lambda_i y_i z_Ri with lambda_i >= 0
single_formal_conditional_family.background_certificate: -z_Q = sum_i lambda_i y_i z_Ri with lambda_i >= 0
single_formal_conditional_family.certificate_scope: All members of this nonempty affine-linear family have the stated query sign, not a universal semantic correctness certificate
single_formal_conditional_family.policy_expression: FG certificate -> FG; BG certificate -> BG; otherwise/empty/unsolved -> complete FoRIS
single_formal_conditional_family.prediction_frame_contract: Not frozen. A certificate for a pooled descriptor cannot automatically authorize every pixel or a separate original export.

proof.sufficiency: Positive reference margins summed with nonnegative coefficients yield the certified query margin.
proof.necessity: Outside the finite generated cone, a separating direction preserves all reference inequality constraints while driving the query margin to the opposite sign.
assumptions: decision class is exactly this affine-linear family

why_cached_proxies_do_not_implement_it: Strictly convex ridge all-minimizers collapse to one old fit
Source-span preserves source binary predictions, not exact legal reference mask labels
A norm/risk tolerance/GP prior adds a new unvalidated scale or family
Mean foreground/background fields, calibration positivity and mask votes are not cone witnesses
Region-average consensus does not imply each edited pixel's sign
legal_cached_observations_that_could_sup: Already bound whole R/query O24 vectors and the declared representation transform
Reference binary mask and its exact official role assignment/continuous coverage, with mixed and fallback roles explicit
Strong FoRIS task/background readout for fallback and complete final output, with its source and frame contract bound
content.single_missing_identification_content: A legal, explicit admissible task family whose agreement is relevant to the real transferred task, rather than certainty manufactured by excluding valid explanations.
content.low_cost_status: Not established. High-dimensional cone feasibility per query cannot be claimed equivalent to ridge or a variance dot product; no new timings or LP were run.
falsifiable_future_obligations_if_adopte: Keep one fixed family and legal R labels; provide a nonempty feasible witness and verifiable nonnegative cone witness for every authorized edit
Use complete FoRIS fallback and one bound frame/export; no region-mean-to-pixel or canonical-to-original certificate jump
Expose gross edit tradeoffs on positive cleanup and harmful deletion/expansion counterexamples with simple and matched-budget controls
Reject if empty, uninformative, wrong on complete outputs or too costly; do not silently change norm/family/tolerance to keep the certificate name
content.current_decision: No prediction protocol freeze or production. The unconditional semantic certificate is unsupported; only the mathematically conditional principle is retained.

A6_all_geometry_summary.purpose: Nine geometries across full11477 tasks; separate GT majority, exact episode union oracle and class-pooling oracle, plus complete small-target capacity evidence.

notes: 所有区域/描述子先在GT-free inference_only内保存并全队列封存，之后才读取query GT。
GT多数仅为像素错误最小化诊断，不称IoU上界。精确oracle按TP/(TP+FP)排序扫描前缀，分母保留全部GT。
oracle_episode逐例最大化IoU；oracle_class联合同域(fold,global_class)所有区域最大化正式pooled-I/U。
每个区域二值决策nearest到1024，训练读出与上界使用完全相同的区域几何。
kmeans K16/32/64/128/256迭代6次；三个tau共享完整cosine/average树，无PCA；空间四邻接固定K64。
oracle区间是固定GT选择掩码的描述性重采样，不代表无监督方法的泛化收益。
完整explore为计划监督范围；seed150仅是首轮诊断，不能替代完整计划结论。

content.reference_support_scope: Mask coverage geometry and archived reference calibration, not embedding semantic purity

groups.kind: Existing exact R/Q visual input with distinct reference masks; GT still only task scoring

deepglobe_road.example_scope: Post-seal extreme per-episode IoU differences for explanation only; not production selection or pooled Deep contribution

metric_policy.scope: exposed pilot observed slots; NOT official 303-slot score

paco_part.example_scope: Post-seal extreme per-episode IoU differences for explanation only; not production selection or pooled Deep contribution

query_and_old_input_guard.guard: builtins.open/io.open/os.open deny every frozen query mask path through complete mask seal

production_cost.costs_scope: Existing cache IO + six-arm CPU feature computation/render/write; not cold end-to-end

pro_fixed200.cost_scope: Successful measured cache CPU stages; failed attempt and setup times not captured. Historical encoding totals are superset actual records, not a Pro200 subset cold estimate.
pro_fixed200.shuffle_scope: Shuffled registration changes direction and alpha; not an amplitude-matched physical-identity intervention

N6200_mechanism_summary.interpretation_limits: Case selection and oracle inputs remain as specified by original content; do not treat them as random-cohort causal estimates.
